paragraphs: See the entry Rav Mesharshiya, grandson of Rav Acha bar Rav.[^1]

notes.text: בר בריה literally gives son of his son: the target is Rav Mesharshiya, grandson through a son of Rav Acha bar Rav. The connected target is not split after “of Rav.” The heading has no personal title; all three target Rav occurrences are explicit.
